newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nova makes 30 cents/shr for Techway.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nova makes 30 cents/shr for Techway.

text.p: Nova Pacific Ltd said on Friday it would make an on-market offer for Techway Ltd for 30 cents a share.

Broker SBC Warburg said it would stand in the market on behalf of Nova from January 27 to February 26 to acquire all the issued capital of Techway. The offer values the computer services group at A$3.78 million.
On Thursday, Nova said it had a 10.1 percent stake in Techway. Nova is 40 percent owned by RG Capital Pty Ltd, which in turn is controlled by Australian television entrepreneur Reg Grundy.
Both Techway and Nova last traded on January 8 at 30 cents and 26.5 cents, respectively.
